Title: Site Engineer, Mechanical Engineer
Description: **Objective of the Position:** The Site Engineer will address the needs for construction supervision, quality control, and time management in a large industrial project within Attica by the company. **Job Description:** - **Monitoring – Supervision of Works:** Presence at sites to monitor progress. Manage supplies and materials, and resolve issues that arise during operations. - **Quality Control:** Ensure tasks are performed according to technical specifications and quality standards. Oversee receipt and inspection of materials and construction processes. Maintain a high image of workmanship. - **Scheduling and Time Management:** Ensure tasks are completed within set timeframes, and the project progresses according to schedule. - **Health and Safety:** Monitor compliance with health and safety regulations at the workplace and ensure workers adhere to these rules. - **Communication and Reporting:** Maintain contact with the project manager of the work and provide reports on project progress, any issues, and budget adherence. Communicate as necessary with client representatives and various company departments. - **Collaboration with Other Professionals:** Collaborate with project contributors such as architects, engineers, technical consultants, construction contractors, and suppliers to coordinate tasks and resolve technical issues. - **Conducting Measurements and Re-measurements:** Conduct measurements and re-measurements of tasks and required materials for orders. Prepare client and subcontractor invoices. **Requirements:** - **Education:** Engineer with a degree from an University or Technical Educational Institute (TEI). Excellent knowledge of English. Proficiency in computers, MS Office, AutoCAD (Basic Knowledge). - **Experience:** At least 10 years of prior service in a similar position. Experience in construction projects is required. Experience in industrial projects will be considered. **Skills:** - **Communication Skills:** Good communication skills for effective interaction with the team and other professionals. - **Organizational Skills:** Possess organizational skills for effective scheduling and management of tasks. - **Problem-Solving Skills:** Ability to address issues and find solutions during the project. - **Adaptability:** Be flexible and able to adapt to changes and unforeseen circumstances. - **Good Judgment:** Ability to make decisions based on logical criteria and data analysis. **Benefits:** - Free Private Insurance - Free access to a gymnasium and nutritionist - Work incentives and coverage of expenses for work outside the office - Provision of laptops, company mobile phones, etc. - Development and training programs - Social Involvement Activities - Opportunity to advance in one of the leading companies in the sector with international prospects AGT Group

Title: "Δρομέας"
Description: Optimal, on behalf of a leading tourism and hospitality real estate company, is seeking a Runner for its facilities in Mykonos. As a Runner, you will report to the Runners Department Manager during the season (April – October) and to the Facility Manager during the winter months (November – March), ensuring that all balconies and outdoor areas of the property are clean, organized, and maintained according to the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and aesthetics. Your daily tasks include cleaning and washing balconies and outdoor areas in accordance with hotel standards. You will ensure timely cleaning and organization of these spaces. Additionally, you will transport and organize supplies (cleaning materials, linens, consumables) to designated areas. You will assist the Concierge/Front Office with simple transfers (luggage, hospitality equipment, special guest requests). You will be present at the pier during ship arrivals or departures, ensuring adherence to safety regulations. You will support the Housekeeping department in quick room changes and check-in/check-out processes. You will monitor and report maintenance needs or damages in areas and balconies to the Manager. Waste management and cleanliness of machinery rooms and utility spaces are also your responsibility. You will operate company vehicles for safe staff transportation. Assistance with Technical Services or Gardening tasks is required when needed. Participation in inventories, emergency situations (weather events, power outages, fire safety), and other processes as defined by internal regulations is expected. Requirements include at least 2 years of experience in a similar position. Good knowledge of the Greek language is essential. Good oral communication skills in English are desirable but not mandatory. A driving license and driving experience are required. You should exhibit courtesy and customer service orientation, teamwork, diligence, and responsibility. Attention to detail, observance, and methodical work are important. Knowledge of hygiene, safety rules, and high-standard services is necessary. Valid residency and work permits are required. We offer accommodation in Elia, one meal per working day, and snacks. Transportation from/to the hotel is provided. A ferry ticket for travel to and return from Mykonos throughout the season is included. About Optimal: Since 2005, Optimal has offered unparalleled, personalized human resource services to large organizations. We are proud to provide a comprehensive business support platform to our clients through six departments: Talent Acquisition, HR Strategy & Talent Development, Learning & Development, Workforce Management, Recruiting, and Outplacement.

Title: Επαγγελματίες Συμβουλών Φορολογικής Διαχείρισης Επιχειρήσεων
Description: At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals! At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We'll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki, and Crete and contribute to building a better working world. The opportunity: The Greek EY ΤΑΧ team was named "Greece Tax Advisory Firm of the Year" in ITR (International Tax Review) EMEA Tax Awards 2025 for the 15th time overall - and the second consecutive year, distinguishing itself as a leader in TAX services in Greece. Business Tax Services helps clients succeed by assisting them with the strategic and operational challenges faced by their tax functions. A global team that helps build sustainable tax strategies; assesses, improves, and monitors tax functions' processes, controls, and risk management; and supports clients in managing effective relationships with tax authorities. As a Business Tax Advisory professional, you'll join an integrated global network of talented consultants working in a dynamic, fast-moving, and commercially driven environment. You'll actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships and identify and escalate opportunities for EY. You'll also participate in analyzing tax opportunities and benefits, assist clients in identifying and managing strategic opportunities and risks that relate to significant prospective planning, and provide tax-related domestic and cross-border planning and compliance assistance to business-connected individuals and their associated entities. In return, you can expect the support of some of the most engaging colleagues around, as well as plenty of opportunities to progress your career. Your key responsibilities: Everything you will do will come back to providing special tax advice services for our clients, focusing on business tax advisory and corporate. Structures. Colleagues and clients from a diverse array of backgrounds will look to you first for answers, so you will be a high-profile contact when it comes to resolving complex issues. As you build your knowledge and experience, you will become a tax advisor, influencing clients and engagement teams on resolutions that will impact entire industries. **Skills and Attributes for Success:** - **Teamwork:** Encouraging an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented working environment by maintaining cooperative relationships and positive attitudes that lead to open communications and sharing of information. - **Communication:** Integrating with and influencing clients from a varying range of organizations, as part of a diverse and highly driven team with a creative vision and the confidence to make it happen. - **Attention to Detail:** Illustrating critical thinking, professionalism, high level of self-motivation, and ability to work in a multi-tasking and results-oriented working environment with keen attention to high quality and details. - **Tech-Oriented:** Using technology to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery. **Qualifications:** To qualify for the role you must have 0 - 2 years of relevant working experience. A university degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or Law is required. Substantial MS Office knowledge is essential. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English are necessary. Strong teamwork and leadership/project management skills are needed. A results-oriented approach with keen attention to high quality, details, and accuracy is important. Self-motivation and a desire to exceed expectations are crucial. **Working Location:** Athens **What We Look For:** What's most important is that you're dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You'll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation, and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You'll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions, and the confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you've got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you. **What We Offer You:** Ability to Shape Your Future with Confidence by: - Developing your professional growth: You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges, and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success. - Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. Advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before. Empowering your personal fulfillment: We focus on your financial, social, mental, and physical wellbeing. Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income [truncated]

Title: WAREHOUSE SHIFT SUPERVISOR
Description: Job Purpose As a Warehouse Shift Supervisor, you will actively participate in a wide range of warehouse operations. The role requires the ability to manage large teams and cooperate effectively with other departments. We are seeking a talented individual with strong people management skills and attention to detail, eager to join an exceptional team. A professional willing to grow within the fast-paced food retail business sector. What You Will Focus On - Lead, supervise, and motivate the warehouse shift team, ensuring effective task allocation and smooth daily operations. - Lead all core warehouse processes (receiving, storage, order picking, loading) while ensuring compliance with established procedures and standards. - Monitor shift performance through key KPIs and ensure achievement of operational targets. - Ensure hygiene, quality, and safety compliance by overseeing adherence to health & safety regulations among all shift personnel. - Oversee the correct use of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and prepare shift reports based on system data. - Manage shift schedules, absences, and leave planning for warehouse employees. - Address operational issues promptly, making real-time decisions to maintain workflow continuity. - Collaborate with other departments (Transport, Quality, Inventory, HR) to support business needs and operational efficiency. Who We Are Looking For - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a relevant field. A Master's degree will be considered an asset. - 2-5 years of working experience in a similar position, preferably in a multinational company. - Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office (especially Excel). - Experience with ERP Systems and WMS. - Very good knowledge of the English language (both written and verbal). Your Value - Teamwork, cooperation, and strong interpersonal skills. - Results orientation and accountability. - Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time-management skills. Start your retail journey and live our values of care, teamwork, humor, integrity, and courage! We care for you by providing room to grow and develop through numerous opportunities for learning, professional development, and career advancement. A safe and healthy workplace with a friendly environment that respects each employee's individuality and personality. Member of Ahold Delhaize—a place where everyone belongs. We strive to be a better place to work where our associates reflect the markets we serve, their voices are heard and valued, they find purpose in their work, and can grow and contribute to their fullest. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Certified by Diversity Charter Greece and SHARE Equality Label, we give the best of ourselves to make the best in people's lives.

Title: Υπεύθυνος Εταιρικής Επικοινωνίας
Description: If you're driven to understand how a company's words and actions shape its reputation, this is your opportunity to make an impact at scale. As Corporate Communications Manager at Ahold Delhaize Group, you will help shape our international narrative. Positioning us as a leader in tech and AI, guiding senior-level issue and crisis management, and strengthening trust with diverse stakeholders. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution at the heart of an international retail organization. About Ahold Delhaize We're Ahold Delhaize, one of the world's largest food retail groups and a leader in both supermarkets and e-commerce. Together with our 17 strong local retail brands in the United States, Europe, and Indonesia, we make a meaningful difference in the lives of our brands' customers, our people, and the world around us. We offer a highly dynamic, international work environment in which our associates thrive. Your new work environment As Manager Corporate Communications, you will join our Group Communications team. Together, we shape how customers, associates, investors, and other stakeholders see Ahold Delhaize. We manage our reputation and bring the company's mission and values to life through communications on topics such as sustainability, inclusion, and tech/AI. With responsibility for international communications across two continents, the impact of our work is far-reaching. We are a dynamic team with diverse backgrounds, united by the ambition to make a real difference. You will have the freedom and responsibility to take ownership of your work while broadening your horizons through close collaboration with colleagues from our great local brands in different countries. We support one another and actively invest in developing talent and skills for the future. Key responsibilities of your role You will work on a variety of assignments that cover the full scope of external communications, reputation management, and leadership positioning, including: Proactive communications / PR on tech/AI: You will take full ownership of external communications and leadership positioning in a key strategic area for our company: Tech and AI. To ensure Ahold Delhaize is positioned as a leader in this innovative field, you will liaise closely with senior stakeholders, lead the development of key content, and work with external partners such as journalists and conference organizers. In addition, as part of our proactive positioning, you will oversee the social media strategy. Lead issue & crisis management: Together with Ahold Delhaize's spokespersons, you will develop proactive approaches to manage a wide range of issues affecting our company and/or our local brands. You will also prepare for potential crises and take a leading role in managing them when they arise. **Monitor Reputation Tracking (via external agency)** What gets measured, gets managed. You will lead our reputation tracking in collaboration with an external research agency, covering both the Ahold Delhaize brand and the strong local brands within our family. This enables close collaboration with leadership teams at the local brands and the effective presentation of insights and outcomes. **What's in it for you?** Aside from what we ask of you in this role, we also have a great deal to offer you: plenty of growth opportunities and various cross-brand career options; flexible working hours; a hybrid working model (we ask you to spend at least 50% of your working time at the office); and the chance to drive meaningful change on a global scale. You can look forward to a good work-life balance, and the chance to work in an inclusive environment that wholeheartedly encourages growth and welcomes you just the way you are. **Plus:** - A gross annual salary between €96K to €108k including holiday pay based on full-time employment - Attractive bonuses - A first-rate pension plan - 20 vacation days and the option to buy an additional 12.5 days from your personal ‘flex budget’ - Travel expenses, a lease car or an NS travel card - A laptop and smartphone - The possibility to work from abroad for a maximum of 4 weeks per year **Requirements** We think you'll be best geared for success if you meet the following requirements: - A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Communications, Business, Finance, or a related field - 6-12 years of relevant experience in corporate communications, preferably in a complex or regulated environment - Experience working in an international and/or matrix organization is a plus - Strong analytical skills, the ability to think strategically and advise at a senior level - Knowledge of Dutch and Belgian society and the political landscape is considered an asset - Fluent in English; fluency in Dutch is a plus but not required In addition to these hard skills, we value a strong set of soft skills. You are a proactive go-getter with strong people skills and the ability to think creatively. A high level of independence, energy, decisiveness, experience in boardroom interactions, and enthusiasm will help you succeed in this role. "This is a role for someone who enjoys making sense of a fast-changing world and thinking a few steps ahead. You'll have the space to work independently, bring fresh perspectives, and shape our approach. I believe in trust over control, and "In working closely together when it matters most." - Elvira Bos, Director Corporate Communications Apply now! Are you eager to join the Communications team? Even if you don't meet every requirement but still believe your personality and skills make you a suitable candidate, we strongly encourage you to reach out to us. Apply now via the button on this page, or feel free to contact Damjan Bugarski, Talent Acquisition Specialist at [email protected] if you have any questions. At Ahold Delhaize and our local brands, we broadly define diversity as being inclusive of thoughts and skills, generational differences, LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, [truncated]

Title: Cashier/Pump Operator at NIS Petrol or Gazprom Gas Station
Description: Cashier / Attendant We are NIS. Our network of NIS Petrol and Gazprom petrol stations is the largest in Serbia, with over 300 sales outlets across the country. If you are interested in starting or continuing your career in a team that employs more than 13,000 people, apply for a job at our petrol stations. Key points about the position: All employees at our petrol stations are hired directly through our company – without agency employment, with an employment contract from day one. In addition to basic pay, there are monthly bonuses and opportunities for permanent employment. Outstanding individuals have the opportunity to advance to managerial positions at petrol stations across the country. Many of our colleagues started their careers this way – either in seasonal or regular positions. This job posting covers the entire region of Serbia and is always open for applications. If there are no current openings in your area, we will keep your resume on file and contact you when we have a hiring need at one of the petrol stations near you. Serbia Employment Contract: Fixed-term employment All medical check-up costs and training are covered What you get with NIS: At the start of work, you undergo paid introductory training at one of our training centers, with compensation equivalent to regular pay. You communicate daily with customers, work at the cash register, and handle sales of goods and services. You perform fuel dispensing and payment collection. You receive and control delivered goods from suppliers, list and display products, and set prices. You maintain order in the sales area. Currently: You possess a minimum of III level vocational qualification (completed secondary school). The job involves shifts of 8 or 12 hours, depending on location. You are prepared for potential night and weekend work, depending on location. You are a communicative person, and prior experience with customers is desirable. You are responsible in task execution. Description: Located on a private peninsula in Ornos, featuring its own sandy beach and panoramic views of the Aegean Sea, Santa Marina, a Luxury Collection Resort in Mykonos, stands as an iconic five-star resort and a unique place for building a career in luxury hospitality. With over 40 years of experience, the resort has cultivated a strong culture of professionalism and service excellence. The resort’s 117 Rooms, Suites, and Villas, all designed with luxurious and chic aesthetics, are nestled among lush gardens and complemented by two impressive infinity pools. Built like a traditional Mykonian village cascading down to the sea, its location is exceptional. Just 10 minutes from the airport, port, and Mykonos Town, the resort offers easy access to everything the island has to offer. Team members have the opportunity to work in a refined, international environment, delivering high standards of service to guests worldwide while developing their skills within a globally recognized luxury brand. Our culinary outlets, including Buddha-Bar Beach, Elais Greek Mediterranean Restaurant, Oasis Pool, and the Beach Lounge, provide dynamic, fast-paced workplaces where professionalism, teamwork, and warm, refined service are essential. At Ginkgo Spa, wellness is an integral part of the guest experience and reflected in our workplace culture, supporting a respectful and collaborative environment. Santa Marina provides a professional, inclusive, and growth-focused workplace where hospitality and service excellence come together. Title: Project Coordinator
Description: Project Coordinator Vacancy Notice: PC_01_GR/26_02 JOB TITLE: Project Coordinator LOCATION: Athens, home-based (with occasional presence at UNICEF as required) TYPE OF CONTRACT: ICMC STARTING DATE: 16 March 2026 CLOSING DATE FOR APPLICATIONS: 08 March 2026 CONTRACT DURATION: Until end of April 2026 ABOUT ICMC: The International Catholic Migration Commission (ICMC) is an international non-governmental organization, whose mission is to protect and serve children as well as uprooted people, including refugees, asylum seekers, internally displaced people, victims of human trafficking, and migrants—regardless of faith, race, ethnicity, or nationality. ICMC started a partnership with UNICEF in Greece to deploy a highly qualified affiliated workforce to assist the UNICEF Greece Country Office. SCOPE OF WORK: The fundamental mission of UNICEF is to promote the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything the organization does—in programme, advocacy, and operations. The equity strategy emphasizes the most disadvantaged and excluded children and families, translating this commitment to children’s rights into action. UNICEF became operational in Greece in early 2016 as an outposted team from the Regional Office of Europe and Central Asia (ECARO) to respond to the significant influx of refugee and migrant children and their families at that time. Following several years of engagement with national stakeholders, UNICEF and the Government of Greece decided in January 2020 to formalize the agency’s presence in the country as a full-fledged Country Office. The office falls under the auspices of the UNICEF Regional Office for Europe and Central Asia located in Geneva, which reports in turn to global headquarters in New York. Within the framework of a mandate for all children in Greece, UNICEF and Greece are now working to address the needs of all vulnerable, marginalized, and left-behind children in the country. UNICEF Greece is currently implementing the Country Programme for the period 2022-2026. The Country Programme (CP) consists of the following four components: i) Social policy and child-rights monitoring; ii) Quality and inclusive education for all; iii) Child Protection; iv) Youth empowerment. The CP marks a shift of UNICEF from humanitarian to development programming and is the first full-fledged programme of cooperation between UNICEF and the Government of Greece. Under the framework of the CP, UNICEF responded to the Ministry of Health's request to develop a comprehensive program to address the issue of family and child mental health in the country. The program promotes the concept. Integrated services at both prevention and response levels are provided, combining technical support and innovative methodologies, from SBC science/strategies to digital solutions. Recognizing the urgent need to focus on the mental health of children and their caregivers within the framework of health promotion, the Ministry of Health and the UNICEF Office in Greece have prioritized this issue and launched the “National Programme for the Promotion of Family and Child Health in Greece 2023–2025,” which was officially signed in August 2024. The National Programme includes three main pillars of intervention: (I) Promotion of family and child health through strengthening the pediatric care framework; (II) Promotion of adolescent health and menstrual hygiene; and (III) Promotion of young individuals’ mental health, with an emphasis on addressing self-harm. RESPONSIBILITIES The incumbent will work towards delivering technical support for implementing relevant programmatic activities in the National Programme for the Promotion of Family and Child Health, as per the below table of deliverables. He/she will be supervised by the UNICEF Child Protection Specialist, working closely with the UNICEF Programme Team in Greece and other support staff. Work Assignments Overview Deliverables/Outputs | Delivery deadline ---|--- 1. Coordinate and provide technical inputs on project delivery, monitoring, and reporting, based on the implementation plans of relevant UNICEF programmes, notably the “National Programme for the Promotion of Family and Child Health,” as well as in relevant programming in the area of child protection. Report following review of deliverables submitted by implementing partners in the framework of the “National Programme for the Promotion of Family and Child Health” | March 2026 (12 days) 2. Contribute to the development of interventions that strengthen the prevention of mental health problems among children and their caregivers at community/municipal level. Report following review of interventions supporting the prevention of mental health problems among children, caregivers, and young people | March 2026 (15 days) 3. Prepare viable recommendations on project implementation, alternative approaches to activity implementation, new initiatives, and optimal utilization of resources that contribute effectively to programme results. Report on project implementation approaches and formulation of practical recommendations on alternative activity delivery options and efficient use of resources | April 2026 (10 days) 4. Participate in and/or facilitate relevant coordination meetings with government counterparts, representatives of civil society, stakeholders, and implementing partners. | 16 reports/minutes of coordination meetings April 2026 (12 days) 4 tasks 4 deliverables 49 days REQUIREMENTS 1. Education: An advanced university degree in one of the following fields is required: Project Management, Social Sciences, International Relations, Government, Public Administration, Public Policy, Social Policy, Social Development, Community Development, or another relevant technical field. 2. Experience: A minimum of seven (7) years of relevant professional work experience in the planning, implementation, and monitoring of programs/projects in related fields is required. Title: Senior Accountant

It works to protect and serve uprooted people—regardless of faith, race, ethnicity, or nationality—including refugees, asylum seekers, internally displaced persons, victims of human trafficking, and migrants. Through its worldwide network of members, ICMC implements and advocates for right-based policies and sustainable solutions to address human mobility challenges. The scope covers finances from seven countries. **Responsibilities:** - Prepare quarterly and final financial reports for all headquarters’ projects, including one global program otherwise staffed by Greece. - Review and recommend other reports prepared by ICMC Finance team members in other countries. - Review monthly financial packages prepared by five countries, work with preparers to ensure corrections are made, and recommend approval/recording to the FTL. - Review and recommend budgets and reports drafted by partners and reviewed by Finance team staff. Work with colleagues to ensure that necessary corrections are made. - Recommend report acceptance to the FTL. - Minimize risk/maximize savings by managing ICMC’s currency conversions and positions. Anticipate inflows and outflows in conjunction with project managers, recording gains and losses as needed. - Act as the main “superuser” in Microsoft’s Business Central environments. Grant user permissions and work with a third party to create access rights. - Identify and promote improvements to system use. Assist colleagues in their use of the system. - Respond to auditor questions on these activities, and other issues as requested. - Work with and learn from the FTL to ensure the knowledge to consolidate global financial reports when the FTL is not available. **Key Working Relationships** Reports to: Finance Team Lead Internal: Finance team members on the HQ team and in ICMC affiliate offices, other colleagues in the Support Services Department. Services Department: Program Managers Worldwide External: Financial auditors, banks, financial service vendors, implementing partners. **Requirements:** - Bachelor’s degree in business administration, accounting, or another relevant specialization. - Minimum of three years providing financial services to program teams. - Experience in an INGO and a program-implementing country preferred. - Experience with institutional, private, and other donor reporting and compliance. - Experience providing audit responses. - Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. - Fluency in a second language (Arabic, French, Italian, or Greek) is advantageous. - Willingness and ability to travel up to 10% internationally. - Experience using ERP systems, MS Office, Adobe Pro, and Web Conferencing Applications. **Soft Skills and Attitudes:** - Demonstrates strong analytical and systems thinking with the ability to see the big picture, exercise sound judgment, communicate clearly, and make effective decisions in complex environments. - Builds strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels; proactive, resourceful, solutions- and results-oriented. - Demonstrates personal accountability, acts with integrity aligned to organizational values, builds trust through consistent actions, collaborates effectively across diverse teams, and remains open to continuous learning. **How to Apply:** Interested candidates should submit a detailed CV of maximum three pages, a motivation letter, two professional references with full and up-to-date contact details, and a Reference Consent form. The applicant’s full name and the Vacancy Notice [26-04] must be quoted in the email subject line. The closing date for receiving applications is March 23, 2026, 1700 CET. Applications will be evaluated upon reception, and interviews with shortlisted candidates may be conducted before the closing date. Referees may be contacted prior to the interviewing stage. Owing to the volume of applications, ICMC regrets that only applicants short-listed for an interview will be notified. ICMC is committed to equal employment opportunities for all applicants. ICMC does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, color, national origin, religion, physical or mental ability, marital status, and age. By submitting an application, you agree that ICMC collects and manages the information that you provide. Your personal information will be treated with strict confidentiality and used for recruitment purposes only. You agree that your data may be shared with staff of donors funding the position, if any. You have the right to withdraw that consent by writing to [email protected] at any time.
